benefits_features.Travel benefits:
The Axis Magnus Credit Card offers complimentary access to airport lounges on travel-related expenses. 
Enjoy unlimited complimentary international airport lounge access with Priority Pass, including adding additional guests, yet with four guest per benefit per year. Additionally, get premium access to add-on cards at three unlimited domestic airport lounges. Starting May 2024, this benefit will require minimum spend of Rs. 50,000 in the previous three months.

how_tos.How to apply:
1. Visit the official website of Axis Bank
2. Scroll down and click on "Credit Card"
3. You will be redirected to a new page where you will have to click on "Axis Bank Magnus Credit Card"
4. You will be directed to a new page where you will have to click on "Apply Now"
5. Select whether you are an existing Axis Bank customer or not. If yes, you'll be an existing customer otherwise not.
6. Enter the necessary details such as your name, state, city of residence, mobile number, your professional details, and your monthly income.
7. Enter the promo code as provided and you will be authorized to fill in the rest of the process for applying for the credit card. Click on "Get a Call Back"
8. A representative from the bank will get in touch with you shortly to guide you with the process of applying for Axis Bank Magnus Credit Card.

faqs.What is the maximum usage limit of the A: The usage limit of the Axis Magnus Card varies from cardholder to cardholder. If you want to know the limit of your card, you just need to log into your credit account or go through the statement of your credit card.
faqs.Is Axis Magnus a metal card?: On the Visa Infinite platform, the Axis Magnus Credit Card is available in a metal form factor. Even without the metal form factor, it has a premium appearance visually, but it is difficult to tell a metal card from a non-metal Magnus.
faqs.Can I pay my utility bill through my Axi: Yes, you can pay your utility bills through your Axis Bank Magnus Credit Card. Not only that but you will also be earning 2 EDGE reward points on spending per Rs. 200.
faqs.What do I do if I have any issues with m: If you face any issue with your Axis Bank Magnus credit card, you can get in touch with the Axis Bank credit card support team by calling 1860 419 0005 or you can write your issue to the bank's official website to resolve the problem.
faqs.What are the required documents to apply: The documents required to apply to Axis Bank for the Axis Magnus credit card are: Permanent Account Number (PAN), Aadhaar card, passport, voter ID, address proof, income proof, and your latest salary slip, Form 16, and income tax return (ITR).
faqs.What are the welcome benefits of the Axi: The Axis Magnus Credit Card offers a welcome benefit where the joining fee of Rs. 2,500 + GST is credited in the form of a gift card. The Portcard Hotels voucher or a Yatra voucher worth Rs. 2,500. The benefit is available after making your first transaction within 30 days of card issuance.
faqs.How can I earn reward points with the Ax: Cardholders can earn reward points in many transactions; earn 15 EDGE reward points for every Rs. 200 spent on monthly transactions up to Rs. 1 lakh. 35 EDGE reward points for every Rs. 200 spent on monthly transactions exceeding Rs. 1 lakh in a month; total retail spend for monthly points up to Rs. 2 lakh on the Travel EDGE portal for monthly transactions up to Rs. 2 lakh; and 9 EDGE reward points for every Rs. 200 spent on the Travel EDGE portal for spends exceeding Rs. 2 lakh in a month.
